Nazari’s age, uniform and competence remain consistent, and the engineering location is unmistakable.

issues.finding: Shrinking marker sizes add an avoidable visual ambiguity.
issues.evidence: The dots become smaller toward the minimum. This may indicate emphasis or motion and does not prove a changing learning rate. Constant-size points would more clearly leave shrinking spacing to communicate the smaller updates.
issues.fix: Keep marker size constant. Let horizontal step spacing and an optional tangent cue show why updates shrink.

issues.finding: Nazari mostly poses beside the answer.
issues.evidence: The static hand-on-hip stance and already-finished descent sequence give little sense of testing a setting.
issues.fix: Place her hand at one control and show a partial path, with the next move still under consideration.

artDirection: Turn the diagram into a small practical trial. One visible knob, one current point and a few earlier positions are enough. The lesson’s interactive trace can supply the exact calculations and alternate learning rates.
deletionRationale: Keep a visual setup for the scalar experiment. The pose and graphic need more purpose, not removal.
newArtOpportunity: ARIA’s unsolicited logging in the ending merits a small authored log insert or waveform beat. A new full-room illustration is not necessary.
delightDirection: Give Nazari the dry satisfaction of testing a mechanism herself. A slight raised brow toward the next point can make the math feel like a hands-on puzzle.

epilogueReuse.observation: The ending adds Demir’s first update and ARIA’s unsolicited logging. Nazari beside a descent curve remains compatible, but misses the new AI behavior.
epilogueReuse.recommendation: Show the small unsolicited log entry in the authored epilogue. Another full engineering illustration would add less than that precise beat.

storyBeat: Demir is paying for a separate forward calculation for each parameter. ARIA has waited long enough to point out the efficient alternative.
intendedEmotion: Comic impatience at repeated work, followed by the prospect of a satisfying shortcut.
observed: Demir sits low left with his temple in one hand, almost repeating the data-loading pose. ARIA’s clear ring sits to the right. The wall contains dozens of fully lit miniature dashboards under a long arc, with only a small bright segment at the left.
strengths: ARIA is clearly abstract and visually present as the second participant. Demir’s face and equipment remain recognizable.
The overwhelming amount of displayed work provides a useful starting idea for the repeated-pass cost.

issues.finding: The display does not make the slow per-parameter work legible.
issues.evidence: The cells contain unrelated waves and charts and almost all are lit. The small highlighted arc could be a progress marker, but it is unlabeled; treating it as an exact depiction of parameter 500 of 673 would overstate the evidence. The stronger issue is that neither the repetitive work nor the reason for waiting is clear.
issues.fix: Replace the dashboard collage with a simple parameter-progress view consistent with the chosen moment. Show one current calculation and a long remaining or completed sequence without pretending each cell is a new plot.

issues.finding: The staging repeats an earlier failure without showing Demir’s growth.
issues.evidence: The head-in-hand pose, left placement and ARIA screen echo data-loading closely.
issues.fix: Have Demir turn toward ARIA with an incredulous look, finger paused over the repeated-run control. Keep visible impatience rather than defeat.

artDirection: Use the efficient-alternative setup as a visual joke. Simplify the work counter, retain ARIA’s calm trace, and let their contrasting reactions carry the scene. Restore a stronger engineering cue in this close crop.
deletionRationale: Keep the briefing. It establishes the cost that makes the algorithm matter.
newArtOpportunity: Add a dedicated epilogue image of Nazari holding a stopwatch while Demir waits through the naive rerun. This changes the cast, delivers the joke and shows earned verification after the exercise.
delightDirection: The best joke is ARIA watching an avoidable wait. Demir can look sideways at the waveform as though asking why she let him continue.

epilogueReuse.observation: The ending has Nazari timing both methods after the learner has implemented the efficient one. The reused image returns to Demir looking defeated beside ARIA.
epilogueReuse.recommendation: Add the stopwatch epilogue scene. It changes the cast and turns the cost comparison into an earned character joke.

storyBeat: Demir lets model.fit repeat the updates, then learns to monitor validation and stop based on evidence rather than a guessed epoch budget.
intendedEmotion: The excitement of seeing the system learn, tempered by curiosity about whether that progress holds up.
observed: Demir stands with folded arms in a dark engineering bay, smiling slightly. A single smooth loss curve falls toward almost zero on the large display. Many smaller panels repeat generic charts around him.
strengths: His calmer stance provides some progression from the earlier crashes. The darkened room gives the overnight run a distinct atmosphere.
The large curve is easy to read as falling loss, and the engineering cues remain consistent.

issues.finding: The single curve leaves out the monitoring decision central to the current lesson.
issues.evidence: The task compares training and validation histories before configuring early stopping. A single training descent is a legitimate conceptual illustration, but it does not show the disagreement or stopping question that gives this scene its meaning. Its near-zero endpoint is not treated as a fabricated measured result.
issues.fix: Show separately identifiable training and validation traces. For a briefing, use an in-progress observation window rather than a completed success curve.

issues.finding: The scene feels like a generic success poster.
issues.evidence: Demir’s folded arms and upward gaze do not engage with the evidence on the display. The many surrounding charts add scale but no decision.
issues.fix: Give him an active comparison: checking two traces, marking a checkpoint, or catching the moment they stop improving together.

artDirection: Keep the nighttime satisfaction but make the monitoring decision central. Use distinct line styles as well as color, reserve exact values for the interface, and avoid drawing the same universally successful curve for every run.
deletionRationale: This is an important change from manual updates to a real run. Keep its illustration and correct what progress means.
newArtOpportunity: The taped pair of curves in the ending can be an authored result artifact. Another large engineering portrait would add little.
delightDirection: Show the small delight of a curve finally moving, followed by Demir noticing the second curve. A half-raised fist that pauses as he checks validation could make that tension warm and funny.

epilogueReuse.observation: The ending tapes both curves above the console after validation-based stopping. The reused picture presents one clean training curve near zero.
epilogueReuse.recommendation: The main two-curve correction is essential. A matched completed-run screen variant or authored taped-curve artifact can handle the ending without an additional broad portrait.

storyBeat: Mirza requests results on unseen readings and evidence about mistakes before allowing a limited supervised prototype test.
intendedEmotion: A consequential review that still feels like an achievable next step, with curiosity about the cases the score hides.
observed: Mirza sits close to the viewer with a hand at her chronometer. Four equally glowing waveform panels form a two-by-two group on the foreground console, with dials around them. She looks outward rather than toward one case.
strengths: Mirza is recognizable and mature, with an appropriately composed expression. The closer framing gives the review weight.
The four-panel grouping and incoming trace leave space for a clear evaluation visual.

issues.finding: The claimed verdict grid does not visually distinguish the four evaluation outcomes.
issues.evidence: The alt text calls this a two-by-two verdict grid, but the panels contain only waveforms. They could represent four cases rather than a literal confusion matrix. The lesson-specific distinction among detections, false alarms, calm cases and misses is therefore missing, not mathematically disproven.
issues.fix: Make the display a deliberately authored category board or show a small set of reviewed cases with predicted and known status separated. Keep exact counts in the interface.

issues.finding: The uniform panels give little visual emphasis to uncertainty or exceptions.
issues.evidence: All panels glow equally green. Green is the general ship palette, so this does not establish that every case passed. Combined with the confident instrumentation and outward gaze, it still makes the review feel more settled than the text.
issues.fix: Give one selected miss a restrained contrasting outline, and direct Mirza’s attention toward it. Do not reveal a final exercise score in the briefing.

artDirection: Make this a review of exceptions rather than a generic command portrait. Mirza can be calm and interested while asking for the case behind the aggregate number. Keep the current face and room.
deletionRationale: The supervised-test decision needs a story image. Its missing evaluation meaning is a reason to refine it, not delete it.
newArtOpportunity: Add an epilogue close scene of Farah alone recognizing sample7741 beside her old sensor-calibration note. The current Mirza briefing cannot carry that private, curious return to the mystery.
delightDirection: Preserve the composed warmth. Let the review feel like solving a puzzle together, and reserve Farah’s more playful, wondering curiosity for the new epilogue.

epilogueReuse.observation: The ending belongs to Farah alone on the quiet bridge, recognizing7741 again. The reused image keeps Mirza and a general review console in view.
epilogueReuse.recommendation: Add a Farah ending scene or a close composition of her recognition and old calibration note. It should leave the cause open and feel curious rather than triumphant.
